description: Security configuration for Retry Storm Sentinel on SAP BTP

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.SupportViewer
scopes.description: Read-only access to integration interfaces, queue snapshots, and alert catalog

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.SupportOperator
scopes.description: Operational privileges to acknowledge alerts, resolve incidents, and trigger test simulations

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.SimulatorAdmin
scopes.description: Administrative control to reset database seed and manage operational telemetry parameters

role-templates.name: SupportViewer
role-templates.description: Read-only access to Retry Storm Sentinel telemetry and active alerts

role-templates.name: SupportOperator
role-templates.description: Operational authority to acknowledge, resolve, and simulate queue telemetry

role-templates.name: SimulatorAdmin
role-templates.description: Administrative authority for prototype seed reset and full governance

role-collections.name: RetryStorm_SupportViewer
role-collections.description: Retry Storm Sentinel - Support Viewer Role Collection

role-collections.name: RetryStorm_SupportOperator
role-collections.description: Retry Storm Sentinel - Support Operator Role Collection

role-collections.name: RetryStorm_SimulatorAdmin
role-collections.description: Retry Storm Sentinel - Simulator Administrator Role Collection
